items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Advanced degree in Architecture, Landscape Architecture, City Planning or other planning or environmental related field.
2 - 4 years of related experience.
Assists in the design and conduct of planning surveys, collecting and maintaining basic data, and preparing reports, drawings and displays relating to current and proposed development. (60% time)

Assists in the review of environmental analysis and compliance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), and related federal, state and local regulations and mandates. Includes coordination with UC Oﬃce of the President professional staff (physical, environmental and legal). (20% time)

Under general supervision of a higher-level planner or Director, provides assistance in long range and precinct plans, facility master plans, transportation plans relating to the organization. (15% time)
Under general supervision of higher level Planners or Manager, provides assistance in local and community planning problems relating to the organization. (5% time)

Knowledge/skill in basic city planning, architecture, landscape architecture, or other planning-related fields.
Thorough knowledge of the organization, including its architectural history, short- and long-range development plans, infrastructure and current, on-going and proposed design and construction.
Written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
Knowledge of California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) and National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA).
Organizational skills.

Knowledge of University of California Guidelines and Policies for planning, capital programs, and major system wide initiatives, such as sustainable practices, carbon neutrality, zero waste, and accessibility.
Thorough working knowledge/skill in city planning, architecture, or other planning-related ﬁelds.
Experience with Windows-based productivity software, including word-processing, spreadsheets, and PowerPoint.
